visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit indoor office space, a man with messy dark hair and glasses, wearing a light blue dress shirt, types frantically on a black mechanical keyboard. He displays an exaggerated expression of stress with a wide-open mouth and squinted eyes while leaning toward a large computer monitor on a wooden desk. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the computer screen, showing a Windows file transfer dialogue box in Chinese, indicating 9% completion for a large file move. (3) A second man with short hair and glasses, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt, enters the frame from the right, placing his hand on the first man's shoulder. (4) The second man holds a small red toy button labeled 'STOP' toward the camera, then presses it with his thumb, creating a still-frame effect. (5) A split-screen comparison appears, showing a 34% transfer progress bar labeled 'After Use' on top and the original 9% bar labeled 'Before Use' on the bottom. (6) In a sudden stylized shift, the second man appears in a black and white maid costume, performing heart-shaped hand gestures against a bright pink background filled with animated heart graphics and sparkles. (7) Back in the office, the first man holds up a pink KIOXIA SSD product box while the man in the maid outfit stands behind him, holding a white teapot. (8) Detailed product shots of the black aluminum-cased KIOXIA SSD are shown from various angles, highlighting its compact size and USB-C port. (9) The first man holds the SSD device up to the camera with a satisfied expression, while the background shows a laptop and a large monitor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-arousal male shouting expressing frustration, accompanied by the percussive clacking of mechanical keyboard typing. (2) A second, calmer male voice enters, speaking in a questioning tone over low-level ambient room tone. (3) A distinct mechanical 'click' SFX sounds as the 'STOP' button is pressed. (4) The audio atmosphere shifts completely into an upbeat, major-key electronic pop track with high-pitched vocal SFX ('Moe Moe Kyu') and sparkling synth textures. (5) A comical 'slap' impact SFX occurs as the scene transitions. (6) The voice quality shifts to a clear, enunciated professional broadcasting tone, detailing the SSD's technical specifications and brand mission over a rhythmic, synthesized BGM. (7) Occasional 'whoosh' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate the narrative transitions between feature slides.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Solution -> Demonstration -> Technical Detail -> Brand Statement
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a comedic skit involving a 'time-stopping' button and a maid costume performance to hook viewers before transitioning into a professional endorsement of the KIOXIA Exceria Plus G2 portable SSD, emphasizing its speed and durability.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is a dedicated advertisement for the KIOXIA SSD, featuring detailed product specs, branding, and a call to action.
